title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Show Currency Symbol/Code and Currency Symbol Position
summary: BC28 (2026 release wave 1) adds a Show Currency setting and a Currency Symbol Position setting to General Ledger Setup, plus a Currency Symbol Position field on the Currencies page. Together they let amount fields show a currency symbol or code before or after the amount.
key_points: General Ledger Setup gains Show Currency, which controls when a symbol or code is shown for LCY and FCY, and Currency Symbol Position
Show Currency applies globally to both local and foreign currencies
Symbol position on General Ledger Setup covers only LCY; each foreign currency sets its own position on the Currencies page
Once set, the formatting is applied to amount fields across the system
The feature was rolled back earlier and is available again in BC28.3

quotes.text: We can now show the currency code or symbol in amount fields, including flexible placement options.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core capability introduced - allowing organizations to customize how currency information appears in their system across all amount fields.

quotes.text: For any foreign currencies (FCY), the symbol position must be configured specifically within each record on the Currencies page.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the key difference in configuration approach: LCY is global while FCY requires individual currency record setup.
